scope: T16/F07/F11 editable linear/radial vector fill paint and inert SVG gradient import/export; full professional-editor roadmap remains active and incomplete

implementation.nativePaint: Optional nullable path.fillGradient value overrides retained solid fill; linear endpoints or radial start/end circles, 2-32 nondecreasing hex/opacity stops with hard transitions, and optional independent invertible affine paint transform
implementation.validation: Strict finite coordinate/radius/stop/opacity/transform validation and defensive input/output ownership; OO constructors/factories/attached setters and shared commands/history/locks/revision checks; separate headless REST conformance
implementation.migration: Valid v1-v22 documents/history upgrade without injecting paint; earlier labels containing fillGradient reject outside the immutable validation cache; original sources/project/workspace formats unchanged
implementation.rendering: Trace geometry under world placement, then fill with world*paint transform active; restore state before subsequent stroke/path. Existing GPU reference uploads/cache keys retain paint. Native tile origins cannot reset gradients
implementation.ui: Native Solid/Linear/Radial selector, color/position/opacity stops, live opacity Slider and precise numeric value, preview Escape cancellation, insertion including coincident stops, removal/reversal, local geometry and disclosed affine matrix fields; shared undo/locks
implementation.svgExport: Validated editable paint servers with user-space coordinates, ordered opacity stops, full matrix, encoded-sRGB interpolation and document-scoped generated IDs
implementation.svgImport: Inert local template geometry, supported numeric/object-box/user-space/viewport lengths, actual cubic extrema excluding stroke, normalized SVG stop offsets, own interpolation property and explicit non-inherited stop-property computation in the chosen definition tree
implementation.cssStops: Preserve unpremultiplied RGB at zero/low alpha using native relative sRGB conversion and canonical RGB/sRGB fallback; out-of-sRGB/unrepresentable colors require explicit flattening
implementation.sourceIsolation: No source image mutation, MP/file-size import cutoff, new service/provider, install-time execution, plugin grant, isolated file/network/asset-byte privilege or REST/browser synchronization
implementation.recipes: Existing layer-add templates retain paint values; standalone path-update recording remains explicitly unsupported

build.result: actual WASM/runtime/developer-doc generation, TypeScript and production bundling passed

production.newCase: Verbatim documented constructor example through isolated Scripts, real inspector and SVG/PNG downloads, independent color samples, one edit undo plus whole-script undo, and editable SVG reimport; no developer globals

importComparisons.method: Retain raw alpha/premultiplied residuals. Require direct interior color agreement; require whole-image premultiplied maxima <=2 for rectangular fixtures. Curved path antialiasing uses independent interior, silhouette, area and centroid checks; not universal pixel equality.

limitations: Full F07/F11 and the overall roadmap remain incomplete. Boolean/richer vector/type/brush/color/RAW/AI/workflow/commercial/specialist requirements and broader interchange/device/performance gates remain.

Only encoded 8-bit sRGB stop colors and pad spread are native. Repeat/reflect, gradient strokes, linearRGB interpolation, out-of-sRGB/HDR/unavailable CSS conversion, degenerate rejected native geometry and unsupported CSS/paint graphs require explicit flattening.

Absolute-unit object-box lengths and viewport gradient percentages with an offset viewBox remain explicit flatten cases. XML/template identity and dynamic/shared definitions are not archived; converted object-box coordinates are native local values.

Template colors follow the tested Chromium definition tree; SVG2 shadow-style inheritance may differ in other viewers. Two-circle/outside-focal radial behavior depends on viewer SVG2 support. Actual old browsers and hardware GPU presentation remain unverified.

Curved/affine/mask edges retain raw raster differences. Direct interior color, silhouette and source geometry checks constrain errors without claiming universal viewer pixel identity or a browser-internal cause.

Relative-color absence is emulated by a real Canvas setter override with restoration; this is not actual legacy-browser acceptance. Software GPU reads premultiplied RGBA8; Canvas/PNG is straight RGBA8.

50 MP elapsed time is a single local observation, not p95/input-to-photon/long-task/peak-memory/device speed or controlled speedup evidence. Native output uses bounded tiles; resident source bitmaps and viewer PNG decode still consume substantial memory.
Standalone path-update recipe recording and wider mask/style graph reimport remain explicitly unsupported; native/project mask composition is verified separately.
validationStages: Initial focused unit test used exact floating-point equality for a quadratic extremum (49.99999999999999 vs 50); corrected to a tight numeric bound without rounding geometry. Final analytical cubic two-root/ID-collision checks are included.

Initial browser run: 12/16 passed. Actual paint-transform restoration lost linear gradient coordinates; the fill now runs with paint transform active. Old geometry-only residual checks were too loose for radial color fields, so direct interior and whole-image premultiplied gates were added.

Corrected initial 16 browser cases passed; expanded radial/focal/CSS/preview/crop/mask/GPU coverage afterward. A Slider numeric-label test locator was updated to its actual accessible value name, and preview values now follow the live command without committing artwork.
A TypeScript mask fixture called an unimplemented ellipse factory; corrected to the actual MarqueeSelection constructor before runtime verification.

An earlier 345-case broad run was deliberately stopped for an actual CSS transparent-stop RGB bug; it had 86 passes, two stale schema-22 assertion failures, one interrupted and 256 unrun. Those two expected-version assertions now match current schema 23. This is not counted as final coverage.

Read-only browser proof showed source center [126,0,128,128] vs incorrect native [0,0,128,128] for transparent red CSS stop. Fixed unpremultiplied conversion and verified exact visible pixels, low/modern alpha and canonical fallback; unrepresentable gamut rejects before publication.

Initial stop/template inheritance fixtures: two passed/two failed. Corrected non-inherited stop defaults and separated own CSS interpolation from template geometry; all eight color/inheritance cases passed. Case-insensitive/whitespace CSS keywords are covered in final unit/browser cases.
Final 999 unit/API, full selected development, complete production, build/typecheck/SEO and whitespace checks pass. Source and runtime hashes are retained; no roadmap completion claim.
